scope: Read-only reproduction and failure/influence analysis; no scientific refitting or model/threshold search
cohort: The same existing recording IDs 1 through 30; no patient-linkage assumption
primary_label: Minimum valid observed SpO2 <=94 in (t,t+30s], complete valid horizon
original_event_definition: Valid >94 to <=94 transition, a single reading qualifies
sustained_event_definition: At least three consecutive low observations spanning >=2 seconds; same frozen fits/cutoffs
alarm_constraint: Reuse existing training-selected budget5 starts/evaluable hour and active cap0.05; fixed references remain explicitly unconstrained
source_hour_rate: Additional descriptive normalization of evaluable alarm starts by the full source duration; not a measured whole-monitoring-time false-alarm rate
uncertainty: Reuse the original 2000 shared whole-recording bootstrap multiplicity draws and verify them against seed20261027; no row bootstrap or fit refitting
paired_lead_estimand: Median difference in matched lead on events detected by BOTH conditions, with recording-cluster bootstrap; misses never assigned zero lead
influence: Leave-one-recording contribution removal without refitting; diagnostic, not new validation
minimum_lead_diagnostic: Fraction of original eligible events with original matched lead >=0,5,10,15,20,30 seconds; no rematching or cutoff tuning
quality: Pre-event waveform/pulse statistics and feature trends are descriptive proxies, not validated SQI or causal explanations
improvement_gate: Do not retrain or change historical code if no verified correctness defect or validated screening rationale is established
